scope: 通用广告与消费者保护、价格标示、商品说明与标签、语言义务、认证与准入（SONCAP / SONMELS / NCC 型式认可）、隐私告知。不含食品/美妆/玩具等特殊品类；不含支付、物流、退换（Layer 3）。
language_policy: 只收官方英文原文。尼日利亚联邦法规以英文在 Official Gazette 公布；本库引文来自 gazette 原文、监管机关官网英文页面。
review_policy: review_required=true 的规则必须人工/律师复核后才能进入报告结论；confidence=medium 的规则需在报告中标注不确定性。

rules.law_name: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act, 2018（FCCPA）联邦竞争与消费者保护法 2018
rules.official_url_note: FCCPC 官网托管的 Official Gazette（No. 18, Vol. 106, 2019-02-01）扫描件；同一文件在 NIPC 官网有副本。文本层为 OCR，引文已按页面图像逐条核对。
rules.requirement: 生产商、进口商、分销商、零售商、贸易商或服务提供者在推广或营销商品/服务时，不得向消费者作出可能暗示虚假或不正确表述、或在任何重大方面具有误导性的表述。是否误导按整体印象与语境判断。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面快照（桌面/移动）、完整可见文案与图片、投放时间与渠道、该表述的事实依据（检测报告、认证、销量/排名数据来源）。
rules.penalty_or_note: FCCPC 行政处罚基准（Administrative Penalties Regulations 2020, Sch.1 item 31）：个人 N1,000,000、企业 N5,000,000；另可能构成刑事罪行。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (1) A producer, importer, distributor, retailer, trader or service provider shall not, in pursuance of trade and for the purpose of promoting or marketing, directly or indirectly, goods or services make any representation to a consumer— (a) in a manner that is likely to imply any false or incorrect representation concerning those goods or services ; (b) that is reasonably misleading or likely to be misleading in any material respect concerning those goods and services ;
rules.notes: 上位兜底条款，不凭词表单独下结论。引文由 gazette 页面图像（A64 页）逐字转录，OCR 文本层存在字符误识，不可直接引用 OCR 结果。

rules.law_name: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act, 2018（FCCPA）联邦竞争与消费者保护法 2018
rules.official_url_note: 同上；引文按 A66 页图像逐字转录。
rules.requirement: 营销中对「重大事实」直接或间接作出虚假、误导或欺骗性表述，或未纠正消费者的明显误解，该经营者须对受损方承担损害赔偿责任，并被命令作出金钱返还。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面原文与截图、涉事「重大事实」的具体表述、该事实的第三方检测/认证文件、消费者误解的证据（评论、客服记录）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事责任路径：损害赔偿 + 金钱返还；行政基准（Sch.1 item 33）个人 N1,000,000、企业 N5,000,000。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (1) Where in the marketing of any goods or services an undertaking or any person acting on its behalf by words or conduct— (a) directly or indirectly expresses or implies a false, misleading or deceptive representation concerning a material fact to a consumer or prospective consumer, or (b) fails to correct an apparent misapprehension on the part of a consumer or prospective consumer, amounting to a false, misleading or deceptive representation or permit or require any other person to do so, the undertaking is liable for damages to any person damaged, and shall be ordered to make monetary restitution.
rules.notes: 「material fact」的边界需结合商品品类判断；功效/安全性表述优先按 NG-ADV-08（需证明）处理。

rules.law_name: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act, 2018（FCCPA）联邦竞争与消费者保护法 2018
rules.official_url_note: 同上；引文按 A66-A67 页图像逐字转录。
rules.requirement: 代表供应商行事的人不得虚假声称自己拥有任何赞助、批准或关联关系。页面出现监管机关、政府机构、品牌方的「认证/授权/合作」表述时，须能指向可核的证书或授权文件。
rules.evidence_needed: 证书编号与签发机构可核记录（SON/NCC/NAFDAC 数据库或证书影本）、授权书、品牌方授权链。
rules.penalty_or_note: 行政基准（Sch.1 item 33）个人 N1,000,000、企业 N5,000,000；与 NG-ADV-02 同一罚则条目。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (2) A person acting on behalf of a supplier of any goods or services shall not— (a) falsely represent that the person has any sponsorship, approval or affiliation, or
rules.notes: 常见触发：把「SONCAP 合规」写成「SON 认证/推荐」，把平台自营标写成「官方旗舰」。

rules.law_name: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act, 2018（FCCPA）联邦竞争与消费者保护法 2018
rules.official_url_note: 同上；引文按 A66 页图像逐字转录。
rules.requirement: 作出表述的经营者位于尼日利亚境外时，该表述视为由「将商品或服务进口到尼日利亚的经营者」作出（展示类表述则由进口该展示物的一方作出）。跨境卖家的页面表述会落到本地进口商/代理身上。
rules.evidence_needed: 卖家主体所在地、进口商/本地代理身份、报关与清关主体、页面实际投放主体。
rules.penalty_or_note: 责任归属条款，本身不设独立罚则；后果承接 s.125(1)/(2) 的罚则。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (3) Where the undertaking referred to in subsection (2) is outside Nigeria, the representation shall be deemed to be made— (a) in a case described in subsection (2)(a), (b) or (e), by the undertaking that imported the goods or services ; and (b) in the case described in subsection (2)(c), by the undertaking that imported the display into Nigeria.
rules.notes: 这一条决定了「中国品牌直邮/独立站」的合规风险会外溢到尼日利亚进口商，报告里应提示责任链，而不是只提示品牌方。

rules.law_name: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act, 2018（FCCPA）联邦竞争与消费者保护法 2018
rules.official_url_note: 同上；引文按 A66 页图像逐字转录。
rules.requirement: 营销中不得使用体力、胁迫、不当影响或压力、骚扰、不公平手段或类似行为。限时/限量/倒计时类表述若与事实不符或制造压迫感，落入本条的判断范围。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面倒计时与库存接口、促销规则与活动期间、历史页面版本、客服话术记录。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (1) An undertaking or any person acting on its behalf shall not use physical force, coercion, undue influence or pressure, harassment, unfair tactics or any other similar conduct against any person in connection with— (a) marketing of any goods or services ;
rules.notes: 「 undue influence or pressure 」需结合语境（价格锚点、稀缺性话术、默认勾选），单看词表会误报。

rules.law_name: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act, 2018（FCCPA）联邦竞争与消费者保护法 2018
rules.official_url_note: 同上；引文按 A67 页图像逐字转录。
rules.requirement: 宣称商品/服务的性能、功效或寿命经过他人检测，或发布相关证言时，须能证明该检测/证言确由声称的人作出并获书面许可。只能判「需要证明」，不能判真假。
rules.evidence_needed: 检测报告原件与出具机构、报告与宣称型号的对应关系、证言授权书、证言人身份与获得报酬的披露。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (1) An undertaking shall not, for the purpose of promoting, directly or indirectly, the supply or use of any goods or services or any business interest, make a representation to the public that a test as to the performance, efficacy or length of life of the goods or services has been made by any person or publish a testimonial with respect to the products, unless it can establish the matters specified in subsection (2).
rules.notes: （2）(a)(b)：须证明该表述/证言由原检测人或证言人先前作出，或事先取得其书面批准。

rules.law_name: Advertising Regulatory Council of Nigeria Act, 2022（ARCON Act）尼日利亚广告监管委员会法 2022 — 配套 vetting 程序
rules.article: Adverts Vetting 页面（pre-exposure clearance / Certificate of Approval）
rules.official_url_note: ARCON 官网（advertcouncil.gov.ng）Vetting 页；同一机关另有 arcon.gov.ng 域名（本环境 403）。ARCON Act 2022 全文未取得（官网仅公开 gazette 前置页），条文级引用留 v0.2。
rules.requirement: 广告在尼日利亚曝光前须经 ARCON 的 Advertising Standards Panel 事前审查（pre-exposure clearance）：申请由广告从业者提出，未取得加盖总干事印章的 Certificate of Approval，属 vetting 类别的广告不得投放；批准可被随时撤回。
rules.evidence_needed: ARCON 批准证书编号与日期、投放媒体订单所附证书副本、投放素材与送审素材是否一致。
rules.penalty_or_note: ARCON Act 2022 的罚则条款未取得全文，暂不写罚则数额；本条只作程序性提示。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: No advertisement under the vetting category should be exposed unless a Certificate of Approval from the ASP, stamped by the Director General of ARCON has been received by the applicant or media house.
rules.notes: 关键不确定性：一是 ARCON Act 2022 全文未取得，无法给出条文号与罚则；二是「vetting 类别」的边界（线上短视频/直播/独立站详情页是否属该类）在公开页面未定义，须律师确认。

rules.law_name: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act, 2018（FCCPA）联邦竞争与消费者保护法 2018
rules.official_url_note: 同上；引文按 A64 页图像逐字转录。
rules.requirement: 涉及商品/服务的性质、性能、优点或用途，以及供应方式或条件的表述，不得错误、欺诈或具有欺骗性。功效、节能、抗菌、环保、安全类表述只能判「需要证明」，不能判真假。
rules.evidence_needed: 对应标准的检测报告（如能效按 NIS 942/943、抗菌按适用 ISO 标准）、测试机构资质、宣称与报告型号/工况的对应关系。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (c) in a manner that is erroneous, fraudulent or deceptive in any way, including in respect of— (i) the nature, properties, advantages or uses of the goods or services, (ii) the manner in, or conditions on, which those goods or services may be supplied,
rules.notes: 本条是 substantiation 的主要落点；与 NG-CRT-03（能效标签）配合使用，能效类宣称应要求出示 SONMELS 注册/标签证据。

rules.law_name: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act, 2018（FCCPA）联邦竞争与消费者保护法 2018
rules.official_url_note: 同上；引文按 A61 页图像逐字转录。
rules.requirement: 展示商品/服务待售时必须向消费者充分展示价格。s.115(2) 把「充分展示」定义为以奈拉计价、附着或印在商品/包装/标签/货架/目录/手册/报刊等可供消费者获取的载体上。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面快照中价格是否可见（含加入购物车前后）、货币单位、变体价格是否齐全、是否需要登录才显示价格。
rules.penalty_or_note: 行政基准（Sch.1 item 27）个人 N50,000、企业 N500,000。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (1) An undertaking shall not display any goods or services for sale without adequately displaying to the consumer a price of those goods or services.
rules.notes: 「问我报价」「加客服询价」类页面在尼日利亚是明确的价格展示缺口。

rules.law_name: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act, 2018（FCCPA）联邦竞争与消费者保护法 2018
rules.official_url_note: 同上；引文按 A61 页图像逐字转录。
rules.requirement: 不得要求消费者支付高于展示价的价格；若同时展示多个价格，不得高于其中较低或最低者。结算页价格与列表页/促销页不一致时落入本条。
rules.evidence_needed: 列表页与结算页的价格截图（含时间）、促销规则、附加费用（运费/服务费）是否在展示价中说明。
rules.penalty_or_note: 与 s.115(1) 同一罚则条目（Sch.1 item 27）；另可按 s.125(1) 主张赔偿。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (3) An undertaking shall not require a consumer to pay a price for any goods or services higher than the displayed price for those goods or services, or if more than one price is concurrently displayed, higher than the lower or lowest of the prices so displayed.
rules.notes: 「划线价 + 促销价」同时展示时，以较低者为准；这条对「原价划掉、实际结算更高」的情形最直接。

rules.law_name: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act, 2018（FCCPA）联邦竞争与消费者保护法 2018
rules.official_url_note: 同上；引文按 A62 页图像逐字转录。
rules.requirement: 不得明知而使用可能误导消费者的商品说明（trade description），也不得以意在误导的方式改动、涂抹、遮盖、去除或模糊商品上的说明或商标。
rules.evidence_needed: 包装/铭牌/详情页文案与实物的对应关系、品牌授权、原产地证明、是否存在二次贴标或覆盖痕迹。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (2) An undertaking shall not knowingly apply to any goods a trade description that is likely to mislead consumers as to any matter implied or expressed in that trade description or alter, deface, cover, remove or obscure a trade description or trade mark applied to any goods in a manner calculated to mislead consumers.
rules.notes: s.116(1) 把「trade description」定义为贴在商品/包装/标签上，或以标牌、广告、目录、手册、发票、商业函件等载体呈现的说明。

rules.law_name: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act, 2018（FCCPA）联邦竞争与消费者保护法 2018
rules.official_url_note: 同上；引文按 A62 页图像逐字转录。
rules.requirement: 经营者知道、可合理判断或有理由怀疑商品的商品说明可能误导消费者，或说明/商标已被改动时，不得供应、要约供应或展示该商品。
rules.evidence_needed: 供应商资质与授权链、进货凭证、页面描述与实物一致性证据、已知投诉记录。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (3) An undertaking shall not supply, offer to supply or display any goods if the undertaking knows, reasonably could determine, or has reason to suspect, that— (a) a trade description applied to those goods is likely to mislead consumers as to any matter implied or expressed in that trade description ; or (b) a trade description or trade mark applied to those goods has been altered.
rules.notes: 举证门槛低于「明知」：只要「有理由怀疑」即落入；平台型卖家对第三方供货的描述负有核查义务。

rules.law_name: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act, 2018（FCCPA）联邦竞争与消费者保护法 2018
rules.official_url_note: 同上；引文按 A62 页图像逐字转录。
rules.requirement: 供应已使用、二手、翻新、重建或再制商品的经营者，必须在商品上以显著方式标示其已被使用、二手或翻新/重建/再制状态。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面是否明示二手/翻新状态、标示位置与显著度、同款新机价格对照、售后条款。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: An undertaking that offers or agrees to supply, or supplies, any goods that have been used or are second-hand or have been re-conditioned, re-built or re-made, must apply a conspicuous notice to those goods stating clearly that they have been used or are second-hand or have been re-conditioned, re-built or re-made.
rules.notes: 尼日利亚 3C 市场大量「UK used / 翻新机」；页面只写「New」而实际为翻新机是高风险表述。

rules.law_name: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act, 2018（FCCPA）联邦竞争与消费者保护法 2018
rules.official_url_note: 同上；引文按 A71 页图像逐字转录。
rules.requirement: 制造商、进口商或分销商必须以能够便捷追溯到自身的方式对商品进行标注或说明（label or describe）。页面/包装上无法识别制造商或进口商主体，是本条的观察点。
rules.evidence_needed: 包装与页面上的制造商/进口商名称与地址、批次或型号可追溯信息、进口商在尼日利亚的注册主体。
rules.penalty_or_note: s.135(2)：自然人最高 3 年监禁或 N10,000,000 罚金或两者并处；法人最高为上一营业年度营业额的 10%。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: A manufacturer, importer or distributor of goods shall label or describe the goods in a manner that will be easily traceable to the manufacturer, importer or distributor.
rules.notes: 与 SONCAP 的进口主体登记相互印证：报告只能写「页面未展示制造商/进口商信息，需向商家核实」，不能推断「无进口商」。

rules.law_name: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act, 2018（FCCPA）联邦竞争与消费者保护法 2018
rules.official_url_note: 同上；引文按 A71 页图像逐字转录。
rules.requirement: 在已知悉上市商品出现未预见危险时，制造商或分销商须立即向公众告知该风险或危险，并使该商品从市场撤回。
rules.evidence_needed: 召回公告与日期、销售页面是否同步下架/加警示、已售出商品的处置方案。
rules.penalty_or_note: s.135(2)：自然人最高 3 年监禁或 N10,000,000 罚金或两者并处；法人最高为上一营业年度营业额的 10%；s.135(4) 消费者可获赔偿。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (1) Upon becoming aware of any unforeseen hazard arising from the use of goods already placed on the market, the manufacturer or distributor of such goods shall notify the general public immediately of such risk or danger and cause such goods to be withdrawn from the market.
rules.notes: 页面层面可观察的是「召回后仍在售」或「有安全投诉但无警示」；不能仅凭品类推断危险存在。

rules.law_name: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act, 2018（FCCPA）联邦竞争与消费者保护法 2018
rules.official_url_note: 同上；引文按 A60 页图像逐字转录。
rules.requirement: 法律要求向消费者出示的通知、文件或视觉表示，须按法定格式（如有）提供；无法定格式时须使用 plain language。判断标准是「目标消费者群体中具备平均识字水平与最低消费经验的人能否理解内容」。
rules.evidence_needed: 说明书/免责声明/条款的完整文本、字号与排版截图、多语言版本、可读性评估。
rules.penalty_or_note: 行政基准（Sch.1 item 26）个人 N50,000、企业 N500,000。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (1) The producer of a notice, document or visual representation that is required under this Act or any other law, to be produced, provided or displayed to a consumer must produce, provide or display that notice, document or visual representation— (a) in the prescribed form, if any, for that notice, document or visual representation ; or (b) in plain language, if no form has been prescribed for that notice, document or visual representation.
rules.notes: FCCPA 未规定必须使用何种语言；尼日利亚官方语言为英语，实务上 plain language 以英文为默认，是否需追加豪萨/约鲁巴/伊博语属 v0.2 待核。

rules.law_name: Nigerian Communications Act, 2003（NCA 2003）尼日利亚通信法 2003 — 配套 NCC Equipment Type Approval 申请要求
rules.article: NCC Type Approval Requirements 第 8 项（提交文件语言）
rules.official_url_note: NCC 官网型式认可要求页（页面自述为 2022 年 10 月版本）。
rules.requirement: 向 NCC 提交的型式认可材料（RF/SAR/EMC/健康安全测试报告等）必须使用英文。面向尼日利亚消费者的通信设备资料实际上也以英文为准。
rules.evidence_needed: 测试报告与说明书语言版本、提交文件清单、报告出具机构。
rules.penalty_or_note: 本项为申请材料要求，本身不设罚则；未获型式认可的后果见 NG-CRT-04。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Upload [ONLINE] APPLICATIONS Equipment Test Reports (e.g., RF (Radio Frequency), SAR, EMC (Electromagnetic Compatibility), Health and Safety) obtained from an accredited test laboratory which must be in accordance with RED Directive as noted above (All the submitted documents must be in English Language):
rules.notes: 页面把「英文」写在括号要求里，且页面自述为 2022-10 版本；Type Approval Regulations 2024 施行后表述可能更新，需复核。

rules.law_name: Standards Organisation of Nigeria Conformity Assessment Programme（SONCAP）尼日利亚标准局合格评定计划
rules.article: SONCAP 服务页（Product Certificate / SONCAP Certificate 的强制性）
rules.official_url_note: SON 官网 SONCAP 页与 SONCAP FAQ 页；SON Act 2015 全文未在本环境取得，条文级引用留 v0.2。
rules.requirement: SONCAP 管制的进口商品须在出口国完成合格评定并取得 Product Certificate 与 SONCAP Certificate；两份文件分别是开立 Form M 与尼日利亚海关清关的必备文件。
rules.evidence_needed: Product Certificate 编号与状态（PC1/PC2/PC3）、SONCAP Certificate 编号、IAF 出具的 CoC 与测试报告、HS 编码是否属受管制清单。
rules.penalty_or_note: 未取得 SONCAP 证书的管制商品「应被扣留、检测，并可能被销毁，费用由进口商承担」（SONCAP FAQ）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Under the SONCAP regime, imports are required to undergo verification and testing at country of supply (Exporting) and a SONCAP Certificate (SC) issued demonstrating that the products meet the applicable standards and regulations or a Non-Conformity Report (NCR) where the goods do not comply.
rules.notes: 受管制清单由 CISS 通过 CBN 增删，本页未列全量 HS 清单；「是否属受管制」须按 HS 编码逐个核。

rules.law_name: Standards Organisation of Nigeria Conformity Assessment Programme（SONCAP）尼日利亚标准局合格评定计划
rules.official_url_note: SON 官网 SONCAP FAQ 页。
rules.requirement: 货物已离开发货国后无法再补办 SONCAP 证书；此种情形适用 SONCAP Default，按货值 CIF 的 20% 或 200 万奈拉（取较高者）收取。
rules.evidence_needed: 提单/装运日、是否在装运前完成认证、CIF 货值、清关时的处理记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: SONCAP Default：20% CIF 或 N2,000,000，取较高者。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: What is applicable at this stage is the SONCAP Default, which shall be charged at 20% CIF of the consignment or 2 million Naira, whichever is higher
rules.notes: 该数字来自 FAQ 问答体，非条例条文；收费基数（CIF 认定）与豁免情形需以 SON 现行公告为准。

rules.law_name: Standards Organisation of Nigeria Mandatory Energy Labeling Scheme（SONMELS）尼日利亚强制能效标识计划
rules.article: SONMELS 实施时间表（Phase I / Phase II 强制贴标）
rules.official_url_note: SON 官网 SONMELS 页。2026 年 SONMELS Regulations 仍为征求意见稿（该页另有 draft regulations 征求意见公告），条文效力待定。
rules.requirement: Phase I 受管制家电（冰箱/冷柜、房间空调、CFL/LED 灯管）与 Phase II（管道式与多联空调、电机、风扇、电视、储水式热水器）须在 2026 年 12 月起加贴能效标签方可进入市场；能效宣称应与标签等级一致。
rules.evidence_needed: SONMELS 注册号/能效标签图样、按 NIS 942/943/1209 出具的测试报告、型号与标签等级的对应关系。
rules.penalty_or_note: 罚则未在公开页面列明；2026 年条例仍为草案（征求意见截止后可能调整生效日与范围）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Full enforcement requiring all appliances within Phase I scope to display energy labels for market access by December 2026 .
rules.notes: 页面把日期与句号分行排版，引文按语义合并；Phase I/II 的具体品类清单见该页 Regulated Products 表。

rules.law_name: Nigerian Communications Act, 2003（NCA 2003）尼日利亚通信法 2003 — NCC Equipment Type Approval
rules.article: NCC Type Approval 页（Equipment Type Approval 的定义与适用主体）
rules.official_url_note: NCC 官网型式认可页；页面援引 Type Approval Regulations 2024 与 NCA 2003。
rules.requirement: 通信设备在进口、营销、供应、销售、部署或接入公共通信网络之前，须取得 NCC 的 Equipment Type Approval；制造商、授权代表、进口商、分销商与授权卖家均可申请。蜂窝类设备在获批后还可能需要完成 Device Checker 的 IMEI/TAC 登记。
rules.evidence_needed: Type Approval 证书与获批型号清单、型号/变体是否在证书覆盖范围内、Device Checker 登记记录、测试报告与认可实验室名单。
rules.penalty_or_note: 罚则条款在 Type Approval Regulations 2024 中，本环境未取得该条例全文；未获批设备的处置以 NCC 执法为准。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Equipment Type Approval is the process by which the NCC evaluates and approves communications equipment before it can be imported, marketed, supplied, sold, deployed, or used on public communications networks in Nigeria.
rules.notes: 页面自述「Typt Approval Regulations, 2024」但未给出条文号；证书只覆盖具体型号/变体，新型号需另行申请。

rules.law_name: Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023（NDPA）尼日利亚数据保护法 2023
rules.official_url_note: NCC 官网文档库托管的 Official Gazette（No. 119, Vol. 110, 2023-07-01）PDF，数字文本层（非 OCR）。NDPC 官网亦发布该法（其为翻页书形式）。
rules.requirement: 个人数据处理须以公平、lawful、透明的方式进行；控制者与处理者对数据处理负有注意义务，并须就本法原则展示问责（accountability）。
rules.evidence_needed: 隐私政策全文、数据处理清单（目的/类别/接收方）、问责措施（DPO、记录、影响评估）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反后的执法：s.47 合规令、s.48 执行令；罚则上限见 s.48(3)-(5)：重要控制者 N10,000,000 或上一财年营业额 2%（取高），其他 N2,000,000 或 2%（取高）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (a) processed in a fair, lawful and transparent manner ;
rules.notes: 原则性条款，需结合具体处理活动判断；s.24(3) 另设注意义务与问责要求。

rules.law_name: Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023（NDPA）尼日利亚数据保护法 2023
rules.official_url_note: 同上。
rules.requirement: 数据处理须具备法定依据：数据主体已给予且未撤回的同意，或为履行合同、履行法定义务、保护重大利益、公共利益任务、正当利益等所必需。页面收集邮箱/手机号做营销时，须能指向具体依据。
rules.evidence_needed: 收集点的同意记录（时间戳、勾选状态）、合同必要性说明、正当利益评估（LIA）、营销退订机制。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (1) Without prejudice to the principles set out in this Act, data processing shall be lawful, where— (a) the data subject has given and not withdrawn consent for the specific purpose or purposes for which personal data is to be processed ;
rules.notes: s.25(2) 对「正当利益」设三项否决条件（压过数据主体权利、与其他依据不兼容、数据主体无合理预期）。

rules.law_name: Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023（NDPA）尼日利亚数据保护法 2023
rules.official_url_note: 同上。
rules.requirement: 同意须是肯定行为，不得以预先勾选的方式取得；沉默或不作为不构成同意；征求同意的请求须使用清晰简明的语言与易获取的格式。控制者对「已取得同意」负举证责任。
rules.evidence_needed: Cookie/订阅弹窗截图、默认勾选状态、同意日志、同意请求文案与语言。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Consent— (a) shall be in the affirmative, and not based on a pre-selected confirmation ; and (b) may be provided in writing, orally, or through electronic means.
rules.notes: 「继续浏览即视为同意」类文案在 NDPA 下不成立；s.26(1) 把举证责任放在控制者一方。

rules.law_name: Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023（NDPA）尼日利亚数据保护法 2023
rules.official_url_note: 同上。
rules.requirement: 直接向数据主体收集个人数据前，须告知控制者身份与联系方式、具体处理依据与目的（s.27(1)(a)(b) 等 7 项），并以隐私政策形式、用清晰简明透明易懂且易获取的格式呈现。
rules.evidence_needed: 隐私政策链接是否在收集点可见、是否列明 7 项要素、格式与语言、更新日期。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (1) Before a data controller collects personal data directly from a data subject, the data controller shall inform the data subject of the— (a) identity, residence or place of business of, and means of communication with the data controller and its representatives, where necessary ; (b) specific lawful basis of processing under section 25(1) or 30(1) of this Act, and the purposes of the processing for which the personal data are intended ;
rules.notes: 其余要素：(c) 接收方类别、(d) 权利、(e) 保存期、(f) 投诉权、(g) 自动化决策与 Profiling。

rules.law_name: Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023（NDPA）尼日利亚数据保护法 2023
rules.official_url_note: 同上。
rules.requirement: 「重要数据处理者」（data controller/processor of major importance）须在成为该类主体起 6 个月内向 NDPC 登记，并申报数据类别、处理目的、接收方、跨境传输国家等信息；重大变更须在 60 日内更新。
rules.evidence_needed: NDPC 登记号与登记状态、DPO 姓名与联系方式、登记信息与页面实际处理活动是否一致。
rules.penalty_or_note: 未登记本身无独立罚则条文，但会触发 s.47 合规令与 s.48 执行令路径；「重要」的认定标准由 NDPC 指引界定。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Data controllers and data processors of major importance shall register with the Commission within six months after the commencement of the Act or on becoming a data controller or data processor of major importance.
rules.notes: 「major importance」的门槛（处理人数/敏感数据）由 NDPC 指引确定，本库未取得该指引全文，故 confidence 记 medium。
